request.style: English, male baritone solo, harp, cello, flute, timpani, solemn and majestic, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A man brought me to the east gate
The door was shut and sealed tight
The Lord spoke from the place of glory
No one shall pass through this sight
For the God of Israel entered here
He stayed within the holy room
Only the prince may sit inside
To eat bread before the throne

[Chorus]
I am their inheritance
I am their possession
No land in Israel given
But my own blessing

[Verse]
He led me to the north gate
The temple filled with glory light
I fell upon my face before him
And heard the command in the night
Mark the entrances and exits
The laws of the house divine
Enough of your abominations
You broke my covenant line
Foreigners entered the sanctuary
Profaning my holy ground
You did not keep my holy things
But let others be found

[Chorus]
I am their inheritance
I am their possession
No land in Israel given
But my own blessing

[Verse]
Levites who went far from me
Wandered after their idols
Bear your guilt and your disgrace
Serve at the gates and walls
You cannot come near to serve
Nor touch the holy things
But keep charge of the temple work
And do all the necessary things

[Bridge]
Sons of Zadok kept the charge
When Israel went astray
They may come near to serve me
And stand before my day
Linen garments on their heads
No wool upon their skin
They shall teach my people well
The holy and the clean

[Outro]
I am their inheritance
I am their possession
